integrity: All theorem statements are restricted to the finite-report, positive-cost framework stated in the cited preprint. The included exact-arithmetic checker verifies a representative instance but is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result exactly simplifies the information-theoretic benchmark \(\Gamma_h\) and its outer lower-bound computation; it does not identify the exact finite-sample optimal adaptive testing cost. The two-mode statement is about the continuous expected-count relaxation. Ties can make optimizers nonunique.
title: Exact finite-hull solution of the selective AI–human testing benchmark
